summary: Iter18 frontend testing complete. Header redesign (Option A) and Inbox split + collapsible top panel + deep-link spinner all verified working as specified. 100% of acceptance criteria PASS on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x812).

desktop_header_1920px.lang_de_persists_and_translates: PASS ('Sprache DE' shown after selecting DE; localStorage.lang='de')

test_results.deep_link_spinner_fix: PASS - clicked Won-tab my-quote-job-*-message btn for one of 45 won quotes; [data-testid=thread-loading] visible during API gap; replaced by message-list after load. No stale calendar/job context shown.
test_results.composer_message_flow: PASS - message-list, conversation-composer, attach-button, message-input, send-message-btn all present; sent 'test iter18' and it appeared in the list.
test_results.booking_message_alignment_regression: PASS - 0 justify-center booking messages found; justify-start/end alignment preserved.
test_results.homeowner_auto_open_first_thread: PASS - homeowner@test.com /messages auto-opens first thread, top panel rendered (expanded on lg per default).

action_items: OPTIONAL (very minor): InboxPage.jsx is 368 lines, spec target was <=360 — 8 lines over. Could trim by inlining helpers or moving the Share Location modal into its own sub-component, but the file is now a clean orchestrator and this is cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: ConversationTopPanel.jsx (line 38): `activeThread.other_pro_id` is accessed without optional chaining. If a future refactor passes activeThread=null this would throw — but currently it's only mounted when activeThread is truthy, so safe.
InboxPage useEffect (line 73): eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps comment is justified (openThread/activeThread intentionally omitted to avoid loops). Acceptable.
Share Location modal is still inside InboxPage.jsx — could be extracted to /inbox/ShareLocationModal.jsx to push line count under 360 cleanly. Cosmetic.
Header.jsx ESC handling: outside-click closes dropdowns, but there's no keyboard ESC handler to close. Minor a11y gap (not in scope of iter18).
seed_data_creation: None. Sent one test message 'test iter18' via the composer as part of regression — visible in pro<->homeowner thread.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter18 (header redesign + inbox split) is fully green on frontend. No backend changes. The thread-loading spinner is observable without network throttling — it was visible on the deep-link click in normal preview-env conditions. Cookie consent must be dismissed via localStorage.setItem('cookie_consent','accepted') before tests; the banner does NOT block clicks but may overlap screenshots.
